items.title: One Video Doesn't Tell You How Good a Creator Is (Distribution Campaign)
items.intent: Educate creator researchers why single-video viral hits skew analysis and why median benchmarks matter.
items.businessGoal: Acquire high-intent creator researchers and drive traffic to /research/ and /outlier-score/.

items.title: The $0 Content Research Stack for 2026 (Distribution Campaign)
items.intent: Provide an actionable, curated toolkit for researching competitor content without $100/mo SaaS subscriptions.
items.businessGoal: Drive qualified discovery from creators looking for free tools directly to Rank Kiwi.

items.title: Why Raw View Counts Lie: The Math Behind Outlier Score
items.intent: Explain the difference between absolute views and creator-relative multipliers.
items.businessGoal: Establish proprietary authority for Rank Kiwi's core Outlier Score metric.

items.title: How to Research 50 Competitor YouTube Channels in 10 Minutes
items.intent: Practical workflow showing how to use Rank Kiwi to bulk sort visible videos and export to CSV.
items.source: GSC Query 'how to research competitor youtube channels' + /docs/workflows/content-research/
items.businessGoal: Product activation and CSV export feature adoption.

items.title: Instagram Reels vs Carousels: Format Benchmark Distribution
items.intent: Show why carousels beat Reels in save rate for 80% of accounts despite lower total reach.
items.businessGoal: Position Rank Kiwi as the authority on Instagram format analytics.

items.title: Rank Kiwi vs Socialinsider & Viewstats: Tool Selection Guide
items.intent: Help buyers select the right tool based on team size, budget, and reporting needs.
items.businessGoal: Capture high-intent evaluators searching for competitor alternatives.

items.title: How Often Should You Upload on YouTube? (Data Drop #03)
items.intent: Debunk daily uploading myths using quantitative upload frequency data.
items.businessGoal: Build inbound citations and backlinks to Rank Kiwi Research.
